Cook Assistant#000.src: Talk to the Cook in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Cook Assistant#001.src: The King ordered me to bake cakes for all those new recruits!
Cook Assistant#001.dst: Kral bütün o yeni acemiler için pasta pişirmemi emretti!
Cook Assistant#001.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#002.src: Unfortunately, a Grook took my last cake, and I ran out of ingredients!
Cook Assistant#002.dst: Ne yazık ki bir Grook son pastamı kaptı ve malzemelerim de bitti!
Cook Assistant#002.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#004.src: That's the Grook! Go chase it down and get my cake back!
Cook Assistant#004.dst: İşte o Grook! Peşine düş ve pastamı geri getir!
Cook Assistant#004.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#006.src: The Grook got away! Return to the Cook at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to figure out what to do.
Cook Assistant#006.dst: Grook kaçtı! Ne yapacağını öğrenmek için [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki Aşçı'ya dön.

Cook Assistant#007.src: What are you doing? Go after the Grook...
Cook Assistant#007.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#009.src: Well, I guess you are going to have to help me find the ingredients and bake another...
Cook Assistant#009.dst: Eh, galiba malzemeleri bulmama ve yeni bir pasta pişirmeme yardım etmen gerekecek...
Cook Assistant#009.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#010.src: There he is again! After him!
Cook Assistant#010.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#011.src: Find out where the Grook flew up to at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Cook Assistant#012.src: Find where the Grook flew up to at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Cook Assistant#013.src: Return to the cook at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Use a Scroll to get there faster.
Cook Assistant#013.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki Aşçı'ya dön. Daha hızlı varmak için bir Parşömen kullan.

Cook Assistant#014.src: Return to the cook at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] Use a Scroll to get there faster
Cook Assistant#014.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki aşçıya dön. Daha hızlı varmak için Parşömen kullan

Cook Assistant#016.src: I can't thank you enough! Here, take these emeralds and armour for all your trouble.
Cook Assistant#016.dst: Sana ne kadar teşekkür etsem az! Al, bu zümrütler ve zırh zahmetinin karşılığı.
Cook Assistant#016.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#017.src: You should explore around to become stronger. I hear there might be work to do in {p}.
Cook Assistant#017.dst: Güçlenmek için etrafı keşfetmelisin. Duyduğuma göre {p} bölgesinde yapılacak işler olabilirmiş.
Cook Assistant#017.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#018.src: I can't believe what is happening to me...

Cook Assistant#020.src: Wait! That's the Grook! Go chase it down and get my cake back!
Cook Assistant#020.dst: Dur! İşte o Grook! Peşine düş ve pastamı geri getir!

Cook Assistant#021.src: I just... I really want to do something that matters, you know? I mean, I came all this way for a reason.
Cook Assistant#021.dst: Ben sadece... gerçekten önemli bir şey yapmak istiyorum, anlıyor musun? Sonuçta bunca yolu boşuna gelmedim.
Cook Assistant#021.speaker: Afelis
